scripts.build:patched: npm run ci:puppeteer && npm run build:puppeteer && npx vite build && npm run build:types
scripts.test:prepare: npm run build:test-runtime && npm run test:prepare:built
scripts.test:prepare:built: npm run test:generate:worker && npm run ci:tests
scripts.test:prepare:prebuilt: npm run test:generate:worker:prebuilt && npm run ci:tests
scripts.test:bundle: npm run test:prepare:built && cd tests && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test:bundle:prebuilt: npm run test:prepare:prebuilt && cd tests && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test:deploy: npm run build:test-runtime && npm run test:deploy:built
scripts.test:deploy:built: npm run test:prepare:built && cd tests && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test:dev: npm run test:prepare && cd tests && npx wrangler dev
scripts.test:full: npm run test:generate:proxy && cd tests && npx playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:generate:proxy && cd tests && npx playwright test --grep "@smoke"
scripts.test:merge: cd tests && npx playwright merge-reports --reporter html ./all-blob-reports
